file_associated_entity_mapping_current: Maps files to biological entities (cases or other entities); grain = one row per file–entity association (columns: file_id, case_id, entity_id, entity_submitter_id, entity_type).
gene_info_current: Holds gene reference and annotation details; grain = one row per gene (columns: gene_id, NCBI_gene_id, organism, chromosome, locus, proteins, assays, authority, authority_gene_id, gene_symbol, gene_description, uniprotkb_id, uniprotkb_ids).
case_metadata_current: Holds case-level metadata and counts; grain = one row per case (columns: case_id, case_submitter_id, primary_site, disease_type, project_name, program_name, project_id, file_count).
